name: @pipeworx/mcp-trove

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Trove collection by keyword. Returns matching items with ids (pass an id to work), titles, creators/sources, dates and links. Requires your own free Trove API key, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own Trove API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at trove.nla.gov.au: create an account, then Create an API key.

tools.name: work
tools.description: Fetch full details for one Trove item by id — a Trove work id (from search). Requires your own free Trove API key, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own Trove API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at trove.nla.gov.au: create an account, then Create an API key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-trove forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the trove pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
